answer: Proof of Stake serves as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, ensuring node influence aligns with capital commitment rather than ephemeral identity. Like a crystal lattice that forces atoms into ordered positions, staked assets create a ridge of financial consequence that prevents identity flooding. An attacker must overcome the river of capital required to control a majority share, as every additional node incurs a marginal cost proportional to the total locked value, rendering mass replication economically irrational.
